quests.title: The Beverly Hills Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Beverly Hills road. Gone since every second Friday, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Olympic Park
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Olympic Park because of one abandoned car, and nobody will put it in writing. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$33 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Minto
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Minto that I am scheduled to kill on the week of the show. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Glebe
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Glebe I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at five in the morning, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$28, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Carlingford
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at Carlingford for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Mascot
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Mascot, dead for 12 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Surry Hills
quests.blurb: Started on a Tuesday. In off the Surry Hills late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and they keep sending a different bloke. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$23 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Douglas Park
quests.blurb: 27 years above Douglas Park. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since a wet Monday the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Rockdale
quests.blurb: 30 years in the Rockdale market. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since every second Friday somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$23 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: The clock on the Pyrmont Bay platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to The Star, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Leppington
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Leppington at ten past five, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Bexley North
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the knock-off out of Bexley North runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$25 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Warwick Farm
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of Warwick Farm after twenty past four. I lock this end and somebody s mum locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Liverpool and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Liverpool
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Clarendon Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 85 boards at Clarendon on the week of the show and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and it has been like that since the merge.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Prince Alfred Square Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Prince Alfred Square. Since the first of the month they have not turned up, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Prince Alfred Square kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $30 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Macquarie University
quests.blurb: The board at Macquarie University says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Menangle Park
quests.blurb: Somebody lost something off the Menangle Park line on school holidays and has not come for it, which never happens. Find out why not.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$24 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Chatswood
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. The long weekend, Chatswood to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Summer Hill Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Summer Hill. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$24, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Coledale
quests.blurb: Third time at Coledale on school holidays. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form
